content: Be silent, for the world of silence is a vast fullness.
author: Rumi
story:
There is a sharp, grounded clarity in this observation. We spend enormous energy trying to present a sanitized, perfect version of ourselves to the world. But whatever emotions or desires we push into the dark don't disappear; they run our lives from behind the curtain.

In Rumi's view, genuine strength is not an abstract theory—it is a lived, daily practice. True maturity isn't pretending you have no dark corners—it is having the honesty and courage to look at your jealousy, fear, and anger in the daylight so they no longer control your actions.
reflectionPrompt: How can you create a moment of stillness today to reconnect with your deeper sense of purpose?
